decision.question: Are both giraffes' markings and substantial interior modeling rendered through chalk drawing?
decision.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' spot patterns and substantial interior shading are visibly re-expressed through chalk marks, layered strokes or form-describing rubbed shading. For each giraffe, examine markings and interior modeling separately across the neck, torso and legs. Identify whether marks construct spot shapes and body volume, rather than merely adding grain or streaks over retained photographic detail. Detailed spots, dark shading and smooth blending are allowed when visibly supported by chalk construction; similarity to the source's anatomy or pattern arrangement does not itself establish photographic retention. Fail if substantial markings or interior modeling on either giraffe remain photographic with only grain, smearing or drawn outlines added. Contours alone cannot satisfy this condition. Return unknown only when visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
